verdict.headline: Anthropic blowout validates AI spending cycle; Hormuz ceasefire expires today
verdict.label: AI capex reconfirmed: Anthropic Q2 $11.5B revenue (+14x YoY, first adj. operating profit); memory semis lead premarket; RDDT MOC auction tonight (~16.7M shares, ~3x ADV); Hormuz ceasefire expires today with talks deadlocked; 30Y at 5.27% — 1bp from trigger
verdict.rationale_short: Anthropic's Q2 revenue of $11.5B (14x year-over-year; first adjusted operating profit) is the weekend's primary catalyst: it directly validates the AI infrastructure capex thesis that CSCO, AMAT, and AVGO altitude declines called into question. Memory semiconductors are the first-order beneficiary, with MU approaching $1,000 pre-market and SNDK +5.7%. The session's binary risk is the Hormuz ceasefire formally expiring today with negotiations deadlocked — any escalation adds an oil shock to a tape already running 30Y at 5.27%, one basis point from the 5.28% regime trigger. Three retail prints (HD Tuesday, TGT Wednesday, WMT Thursday) and FOMC Minutes (Wednesday 2 PM) determine whether last week's consumer data misses are a trend or a pull-forward.

trade_setups.thesis: Tonight's closing auction concentrates ~$2.97B in forced passive buying (~3x average daily volume) into a single market-on-close print. Post-inclusion, price discovery reverts to RDDT's fundamental case: AI-search monetization of its data corpus and advertising revenue durability.
trade_setups.entry: $177 defines the two-session fundamental test (Aug 18–19). $158.12 (pre-announcement close) is the full mechanical-unwind level.
trade_setups.invalidation: Two closes below $177 within two sessions of Aug 18 without a negative fundamental catalyst — passive bid did not extend to fundamental buyers.

trade_setups.asset: 30Y UST (FOMC Minutes binary into Jackson Hole)
trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.27%, 1bp from the 5.28% regime trigger. Wednesday's FOMC Minutes (July 28–29 meeting, three hawkish dissenters) reveal whether September is genuinely live. Dovish minutes + Hormuz de-escalation = compression toward 5.10%; hawkish minutes + Hormuz escalation = 5.28+ breach and pre-Jackson Hole rate overhang.
trade_setups.entry: Two consecutive closes below 5.18% before Aug 25 confirms dovish setup. Above 5.28% post-Minutes = September now live.
trade_setups.invalidation: 30Y above 5.28% immediately post-FOMC Minutes — September hike odds exceed 45%, eliminating dovish Jackson Hole narrative before Warsh speaks.

bear_case: The Hormuz ceasefire expiry is not priced into oil or equities at the session open: Brent at $88.31 and WTI at $82.32 already sit above their regime triggers, and any renewed Iranian action after the ceasefire lapses could drive Brent above $90–$92 before the week is out. That alone pushes the 30Y through its 5.28% trigger before FOMC Minutes have landed Wednesday, hardening the three-of-three regime breach scenario. Add three retail misses (HD, TGT, WMT) confirming July's consumer data as a trend rather than a pull-forward, and the S&P's record-close multiple compresses with only AI/semis as an offsetting growth driver — a narrow leadership base that leaves the index fragile ahead of NVDA's August 26 print. This read no longer holds if 30Y closes below 5.15% on two sessions before August 26 and S&P 500 posts two consecutive closes above 7,870.
